title: Oven Baked Dutch Turkey Ham Casseroles
description: A sweet and light Dutch dish featuring turkey ham, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this satvik-friendly casserole is a delicious and easy meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat the oil over medium heat and saute the onions until they are translucent.
In a separate pot, boil the sliced potatoes until they are slightly tender.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked potatoes, sauteed onions, diced turkey ham, and grated carrots.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and milk until smooth.
Add the shredded cheese to the flour mixture and stir until well combined.
Pour the cheese mixture over the potato and ham mixture and stir until everything is well coated.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
